Hi Kimberly,

We are moving this renewal through procurement and Legal has flagged a requirement to include the latest penetration test report and a remediation/status summary before we can clear the contract (MAP gating window closes on Thu Feb 18). Can you confirm the following by EOD tomorrow (Feb 15):

- A redacted copy of the full pen test report (PII/health-data redactions are fine)
- A remediation log that lists open findings, owners, and target fix dates
- Any scheduled mitigations for high/critical issues and whether we can include a risk acceptance note from Redwood if fixes are scheduled after PO

If you need a formal evidence checklist, I can attach our procurement form — we prefer PDF. Please also loop in your pen-test vendor if you recommend they send the redacted report directly.

We’re hoping to close by Feb 18 to align with our budget cutover; procurement will not approve without the items above.

Thanks,

We will include a named mitigation owner and a proposed risk acceptance statement for procurement/legal to review.

If procurement requires the vendor to send directly to Legal, I’ve copied RedPen below and will ask them to forward the redacted report to your team. Marcus — can you confirm the redaction and encryption approach when you coordinate with RedPen?
